data.body: **[P2] Preserve settled outcomes with synchronous executors.** If the configured executor runs tasks inline, a nonfatal `MDC.clear()`/`setContextMap()` exception escapes through this call even though `result` was completed in the `finally` block. The cleanup error therefore replaces the selected success, suspension, or retry outcome. Guard dispatch exceptions so a result already settled by the work is retained for nonfatal restoration failures; propagate only true submission failures and JVM-fatal errors. Add a direct-executor restoration regression.
